source_evidence: Exact player 'To be frank, I don't know what your charge is. My memory is lacking' V admits ignorance of warder's charge and lacking memory, no command, promise, identity verification or entry. Custodian responds with contemptuous suspicion and describes its historical charge in its own words: safeguarding House possessions and persons placed in custody, prohibiting departure without proper authority. Cirren independently asks whether prisoners or refugees; custodian insists they were wards and departure forbidden. This is bounded testimony of the warder's own local duties and perspective, consistent with fixed refuge-then-confinement history in dm-estate-ancestry.md; not independent proof of exact orders, father's involvement, later victim fate or V's identity. It challenges whether V has authority to release what it guards. No door opening, entry, movement, combat, initiative, check, expenditure, proof or new magical revelation. Fenar remains ready at the closed threshold. V next response.
